core_obligations: Order the five conditions by the embeddings of the field extensions involved, which gives the implications in one direction immediately (proof lines 10658-10665).
Prove the remaining implication by passing to the generic point and using the separability criterion, concluding geometric reducedness (proof lines 10665-10694).
proof_roadmap: Chain the easy implications through the embeddings (proof lines 10657-10665).
Close the cycle at the generic point (proof lines 10665-10695).
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives five equivalent conditions for a finite type algebra over a field to be geometrically reduced, ranging over finite purely inseparable extensions, the p-closure, the perfect closure and the algebraic closure (statement lines 10641-10655). The proof does not check each implication: it orders the conditions using the embeddings between the relevant field extensions so that one direction collapses, and proves the remaining implication at the generic point via the separability criterion (proof lines 10657-10695). Choosing that ordering of the five fields is what makes four of the implications immediate. H2.
